# Introduction

In this section, we will demonstrate how one may combine *vetiver* and *plumber* with *Docker* and *Kubernetes*. As a reminder:

- [vetiver: For model versioning, sharing, and deployment](https://rstudio.github.io/vetiver-r/)
- [plumber: For creating light-weight web applications, and deploying models as microservices](https://www.rplumber.io/)

We will elucidate upon *Docker* and *Kubernetes* in subsequent sections.
